title: All-Order Expansion of the Noncommutative $\Phi^4$ Model
exact_target: Does the proposed derivative formula reproduce every perturbative coefficient of the noncommutative phi-four solution?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003895 (OWR-16407-007). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

status_qualification: The defining transform and boundary-value relations were recovered from PDF page 29. The report checked the conjectured coefficients through order ten and resummed the proposed series with Lagrange--B\"urmann inversion; that resummation alone does not establish that the actual nonlinear boundary-value solution has all those coefficients. The target remains coefficientwise formal validity, rather than an added convergence claim.
